---
name: refactor-guide
description: "Step-by-step refactoring guide with safety nets, code smell detection, and incremental improvements"
---

Guide me through safely refactoring code using test-driven refactoring principles.

Process: IDENTIFY → TEST → REFACTOR → VERIFY → COMMIT

Identify common code smells (long functions, duplicate code, deep nesting, magic numbers, tight coupling) and apply appropriate refactoring patterns while keeping tests green.

Focus on ${file} or ${selection}. Make small, incremental improvements.
